en.multiphysics.model_end_time_hint: Simulated time. The time step follows from the smallest cells, the inflow speed and the viscosity; a run takes at most 20 000 steps, and fewer on large grids (50 million cell steps in all).
en.multiphysics.model_fluid_template: This study was made before fluids could be picked: it runs with its template's fluid (0.02 m²/s) and steps, which do not stand for air or water. Pick a fluid to run it as one.
